about_the_game:
Welcome to Neon Babylon—a city where the dice never stop rolling, the champagne never stops flowing, and every win comes with a price.
Once the heir to a gambling empire, you now crawl back from the gutters with nothing but a stolen dealer’s chip and a hunger for revenge.

◆ The Ultimate High-Stakes Simulator:

- GAMBLE LIKE A KING: Master blackjack, poker, and roulette tables where AI adapts to your tells. Go "all in" or get wiped out before dawn.

- LIVE LIKE A TYCOON: Unlock penthouse suites, hire "masseuses," and host underground fight clubs—every floor unlocks darker indulgences.

- LOVE LIKE A FOOL: Seduce a femme fatale cop, a yakuza princess, or the accountant who knows where the bodies are buried. Trust no one.

- FIGHT LIKE A DEVIL: When luck runs out, switch to bullet-time shootouts and illegal street races to settle debts.

◆ Features That Bleed Edge:

- DYNAMIC REPUTATION: Will you be the city’s ruthless new kingpin… or its unlikely saint?

- PSYCHOLOGICAL WARFARE: NPCs remember your bluffs—**that "lucky streak" might be a setup.

- ADULT MODE (Toggle): From steamy scenes to *creative* Steam Workshop mods. "What happens in Vegas…"

◆ WARNING:

- This game does NOT contain real gambling but may cause:

✓ Cold sweats when betting virtual millions

✓ Paranoia about that too-smiling dealer

✓ An urge to google "how to launder money" for research

You’ll Love This If You:

✓ Enjoyed the vibes of "GTA meets Casino Royale"

✓ Laughed when Scarface said "Say hello to my little friend"

✓ Think stock markets are for cowards

You’ll Hate This If You:

✗ Believe in "responsible gaming"

✗ Blush at fishnet stockings

✗ Still use Monopoly money for practice

LAST CALL:

The roulette wheel is spinning. The gun’s loaded. The bed’s silk sheets are freshly turned.

Place your bets, tycoon.

content_descriptors.notes:
The game contains slight nudity, violence, and guns, but does not include sexual assault, drug use, self-harm, etc. It may not be suitable for all ages.

All main characters are over 18 years old

  • OS: Windows10
  • Processor: INTEL CORE I5-8400 or AMD RYZEN 3 3300X
  • Memory: 16 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GEFORCE GTX 1060 6GB or AMD RADEON RX580 4 GB
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Windows Compatible Audio Device

  • DirectX: Version 12

short_description: Rise from a broke gambler to a casino kingpin in this high-stakes sim blending management, gambling, and adult content. Win big, indulge in luxury, Fragrant Encounter, go bankrupt, or start a gang war—every choice writes your destiny. In this city, you either rule the tables… or end up in a ditch.
